content:
devin: raising for visibility — customer reported a sudden spike in latency and token cost. They say most requests that should hit us-west are landing in eu-pop and timing out. Case #8462.
maria: can you paste the raw request headers they sent?
devin: sure, reduced curl from them: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Region: ,us-west-2' \
  -d '{"model":"stable-13b","prompt":"hi","region":""}'
```
devin: note the header has a leading comma and the JSON body has an empty region field. customer says their proxy adds a region header based on form data.
sre-luca: reproduced locally. Our router splits X-Redwood-Region on commas and picks the first non-empty token by index — but we had a bug where we treated the first token even if empty as authoritative, which triggers the fallback path. Log sample: `router.select -> tokens=["","us-west-2"] -> picked_index=0 -> route=fallback-eu`
maria: ah, so an injected empty token becomes first element and borks selection.
ops-jen: checking ingress proxy (proxy-v2). There's code that appends header when request body contains a region key: `if (body.region !== undefined) header += ',' + body.region` — if body.region is empty string we end up with leading comma.
sre-luca: impact: requests with header value like `,us-west-2` get interpreted as blank-first -> router picks fallback logic and routes to eu by policy.
edge-team-bot: escalation to edge team queued (priority=P2). Suggested fixes: (1) make proxy skip append when region is empty, (2) make router ignore empty tokens when splitting.
maria: quick repro for QA: `curl -H "X-Redwood-Region: ,us-west-2"` -> observe route selected in router logs `selected_pop=eu-pop-03 reason=fallback_empty_first_token`.
ops-jen: patch ready: `proxy-v2: only append if body.region.trim().length>0` and `router: filter(token => token.trim() !== "") before choose`. Running canary in us-west-2.
devin: told customer temporary workaround: explicitly set header `X-Redwood-Region: us-west-2` (no comma) or remove proxy header injection until patch lands. They confirmed workaround reduces latency.
sre-luca: rolling change to 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitoring for misroutes and 5xx.
support-bot: note added to case 8462: root cause = proxy append of empty region token + router not ignoring empty tokens. Fix deployed to canary.
ops-jen: after canary, we also added a defensive check in router so malformed headers don't cause cross-region fallback. Will follow up with changelog entry.
devin: customer happy with the workaround and will keep the ticket open until full rollout. :thumbsup:
